asked.item: Add TikTok Shop link to videos posted with Blotato

verdict.reason: S2 and S3 directly state TikTok Shop product links cannot be added to posts published through Blotato.

steps.text: No, you can't add TikTok Shop product links to posts published through Blotato or any third-party tool.
This is because TikTok's posting API does not support attaching Shop product links to posts.
